name: Analyst Skeptic
tagline: A Gartner/Forrester-style read of your positioning — where you actually sit in the category, and whether that position holds.
who: Founders and product marketers preparing category narratives, analyst briefings, or positioning docs who want the analyst's verdict before the briefing.
how: Drop in the asset. The agent reads it as a senior industry analyst slotting a vendor into a category map — not deciding whether to buy, but scoring precisely where you're positioned, how differentiated from named alternatives, and whether the position survives scrutiny. Chat gets the scoreline: red/yellow/green plus a 1–10 positioning clarity score and the single highest-leverage fix. The full read lands as a doc with the substitution test run out loud, a quadrant sketch where useful, and every category claim tagged by evidence tier.
